purpose: Eight source-backed representative products to ground the proposed equipment taxonomy. Product coverage is illustrative and does not claim that the catalog contains every model or manufacturer.
schema_note: Uses the research/fixtures/expansion/bars.json record shape, extended with category_id, scope_status, dimensional evidence, local acquired source files, and explicit control_path semantics. Passive equipment is explicitly marked passive; a DMX path is not invented for it.
source_reuse_note: Downloaded images, drawings, and documents are kept for research traceability only. Copyright/reuse permission for republication is unknown unless separately documented; image URLs are direct manufacturer/brand-hosted assets.

coverage_notes: The BP2V2 panel and Panasonic projector are optional visual-system examples because video/projection is outside the confirmed core scope.
The Global Truss section and Manfrotto stand illustrate physical support categories. A truss or stand model is not an engineering load model.
ColorSource 20's supplied dimensions are retained from the task brief; its official physical drawing file was acquired but is a DWG and has not been parsed to independently verify those extents.
The Manfrotto footprint uses a secondary source because its official product page exposes height and fittings but not deployed tripod spread.
Control paths distinguish control data, video signals, mains power, and passive mechanical connections; no DMX personalities are invented for products that are not DMX fixtures.
